acces.texte: Your role does not give access to this screen. Ask the administrator if you need it.

actions.due_diligence: Start the due diligence review before expiry.
actions.fne: Obtain FNE certification before sending to the client.
actions.paiement_a_valider: Check the account and approve the payment (dual approval).
actions.point_bloquant: Settle the escalated issue and record the resolution.
actions.retard_paiement: Chase the client and track collection.

alertes.aide: Deadlines from every module and entries awaiting action, within your rights. Same rules as the header counter.
alertes.sources_echec: {{n}} source(s) could not be read: the list may be incomplete. Try again.

ao.aide_depot: Submission requires every document. The reasons for each lost tender inform the next responses.
ao.aide_nouveau: The list of administrative documents is prefilled; adjust it to the tender file.
ao.aide_resultat: A reason is required if lost or withdrawn; it informs the next responses.
ao.pieces_liste: Administrative documents and offers (one per line)
ao.question_placeholder: Question asked to the contracting authority
ao.titre_prochain: submission to {{donneur}} in {{j}} days, {{n}} documents still missing

approbation.aide: A custom order cannot go into production without an approved, signed version. A new version submitted before production cancels the existing approval; afterwards, drawings change by amendment.
approbation.aide_decision: Attach the document signed by the client; a rejection requires their reservations.
approbation.aide_version: Documents can no longer be changed once the version is submitted.
approbation.aucun_circuit: No approval circuit: they are created from the order record.
approbation.titre_circuits: {{n}} approval circuits; {{a}} approved and signed, {{r}} under revision, {{s}} with the client

avenants.aide: An amendment changes a signed order (quantity, specification, price) or a lead time. It is approved by someone other than its author, then the administrator records the signed version: the order price and schedule are then recalculated.
avenants.impact_delai_saisie: Lead-time impact (working days, negative to bring forward)

banque.aide_comptes: An account that has statements can no longer change company, number or currency.
banque.aide_import: Accepted formats: ISO 20022 camt.053, SWIFT MT940, or CSV spreadsheet with columns date, libelle, montant and reference. The file is read on your computer; the database checks every transaction and the balance, and rejects a statement or transaction already imported.
banque.aide_non_confirmes: Receipts by transfer, cheque or letter of credit recorded in the application that no imported bank transaction confirms after the configured delay. Check before any commission or share.
banque.aide_operations: Automatic reconciliation only happens when amount, currency, company and transaction reference all match. Other transactions are matched here, or classified with a reason.
banque.aucun_compte: No visible bank account: the administrator declares them in the “Bank accounts” tab.
banque.aucune_proposition: No matching receipt or payment (same company, same currency, close amount and dates).
banque.autre_compte: The statement account number does not match the selected account.
banque.autre_devise: This statement is in {{d}}, not in the selected account currency.
banque.ecart_frais: difference of {{m}} recorded as bank charges
banque.resultat: {{importees}} transactions imported, {{doublons}} already known, {{rapprochees}} reconciled automatically.
banque.tout_confirme: All recorded receipts are confirmed by a statement.

clients.aide_verification: Verification is mandatory before a trading deal or a letter of credit, renewed every year.
clients.k_encours_sous: XOF · FOB value of open files
clients.titre_verif: {{n}} verifications to complete before any file is opened

commandes.aide_annulation: Cancellation is reserved to the administrator. Amounts due depend on the phase reached.
commandes.aide_approbation: Drawings, data sheets and reference sample approved by the client (phase 0: written approval uploaded).
commandes.aide_contrat: Mode 1: tripartite contract (client, supplier, GBS as intermediary). Stamped contract: check that the name on the stamp matches the business licence. Validation lifts lock 1.
commandes.inspection_avant: inspection must be validated before this point
commandes.introuvable: Order not found or not allowed.
commandes.reserve_achats: Reserved for purchasing and the administrator.
commandes.sans_date_promise: No promised delivery date: no penalty can be computed.
commandes.titre_retard: {{n}} late order gives rise to a contractual penalty
commandes.verrou1: lock 1: no purchase without a signed contract

commissions.aide_contrat: The rate of the contract in force on the receipt date applies. A rate cannot be changed: close the contract and create a new one.
commissions.aide_export: Entries for the period: expense on statement validation, settlement on payment; amounts in CFA francs and in the company's book currency. Chart of accounts to be confirmed by the accountants.
commissions.aide_paiement: Payment is recorded by someone other than the person who validated the statement.
commissions.aide_releve: The statement includes every commission not yet reported up to the month shown, including late receipts and credit-note reversals; a negative balance waits for the next statement.
commissions.aucun_contrat: No contract recorded: the default rate (dated setting) applies.

config.texte: The Supabase project URL and public key are not set (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY).

connexion.code_refuse: Code refused. Try again with the current code.
connexion.erreur_mfa: Could not set up two-factor authentication. Try again.
connexion.identifiants_invalides: Enter a valid e-mail and a password of at least 8 characters.
connexion.inscription_mfa: First sign-in: scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
connexion.texte_securite: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for all internal accounts. Every sensitive approval is written to the audit log.

actions_aide.deposer_cdc: The client's signed specification is a mandatory document of the phase.
actions_aide.facturer: The fee is invoiced upfront, before any sourcing work.
actions_aide.lancer_sourcing: All conditions are met: the phase can be approved.
actions_aide.suivre: Manufacturers' offers are followed in the file.
actions_aide.valider_cdc: Check the document received, then approve it on the file.

consultations.aide_forfait: The fee is invoiced upfront and deducted from the commission if the order is placed. Enhanced fee: in-depth due diligence or multi-lot needs.
consultations.deduction_texte: Fee deducted from the commission if an order follows
consultations.titre_non_regles: {{n}} unpaid upfront fees are blocking the start of sourcing

coque.rechercher: Search a file, a client, an invoice…

couts.aide_marge: Direct margin = fees excl. tax (credit notes deducted) minus costs specific to the file, in FCFA. Collected view: an unpaid invoice reduces the margin. Full margin, per-company view and analytical closing: phase 2.
couts.aide_ndf: Receipt required for: {{liste}}. A claim can be approved once allocated to a file or to overheads; each allocated expense feeds the file's actual profitability. Per-item ceilings not configured yet.
couts.aide_note: Amounts excluding tax (recoverable VAT is not a cost); converted to FCFA at the rate of the expense date. A report not allocated to a file or overheads cannot be reimbursed. Receipt required for travel, accommodation and meals.
couts.aide_rentabilite: Files whose invoiced or collected direct margin is negative, with their main cause.
couts.aide_repartition: The cost is split between files in proportion to time spent; the rule and its reason are written to the audit log.
couts.aucun_cout: No cost linked to this file.

dcl.aide_convertir: Open the consultation for this client, then link the request to its file; the client then sees “Consultation opened”.

dd_lien.aide: Gulf Bridge Sourcing checks every supplier before working with them. Upload the requested documents here: each file is reviewed, then accepted or rejected with the reason.
dd_lien.formats: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, 10 MB max.
dd_lien.lien_cree: Link created: it will not be shown again, send it to the supplier now. The old link is revoked.

types.attestation_bancaire: Bank certificate (account in the company name)

delais.aide_calendrier: Public holidays and exceptional working days per country. Fixed-date and Easter-based holidays are proposed "to confirm"; Muslim holidays and the official Chinese calendar (holidays and make-up working days) must be entered each year.
delais.aide_cibles: Target lead time of each phase, in working days, per file type. Leave empty: no status light for that phase. The light turns orange at 80% of the target (parameter delai.seuil_alerte).
delais.aide_delegation: Your open tasks, the current phases you own and your blocking issues move to the chosen person. History is kept in the log with the reason.
delais.aide_horloge: Working days of the country of the person who must act, public holidays excluded. While waiting for a third party, the internal clock stops and the due date moves back accordingly.
delais.chine_vide: Chinese calendar empty for this year: enter the official holidays and make-up working days published by the State Council, otherwise deadlines in China ignore Spring Festival.
delais.delegation_faite: Delegation done: {{taches}} task(s), {{phases}} phase(s), {{points_bloquants}} blocking issue(s).

depot.aucun: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, 25 MB max

devis.mandat_texte: Phase 0: e-signature happens outside the tool. Upload the signed mandate; validating it lifts the first lock on the client side and freezes the computation at the signing-date rate.

doc.dd_engagement: No-commission pledge signed on {{d}}. Checks: legal existence and licence, export capacity, factory audit, certifications, references, litigation, social and environmental compliance, beneficial owners, sanctions, bank account match.
doc.fne: Electronic standardised invoice certified by the DGI · no. {{n}}
doc.honoraires_separes: Gulf Bridge Sourcing fees, shown separately from the manufacturer's original invoice, which the client pays directly.
doc.pied: {{s}} · document generated by the Gulf Bridge Sourcing management application.
doc.prix_apres_retenue: Prices are stated after withholding tax.
doc.prix_avant_retenue: Prices are stated before withholding tax; withholding certificate to be provided.
doc.recap_projet: Project fee: {{total}}; previous instalments invoiced: {{deja}}; balance after this instalment: {{reste}}.
doc.zh_lot1: Chinese version: translation to be validated (phase 1).

docs.aide_creation: The document is created as a draft; then upload its first version. Terms of sale and documents without a project are not handled here.
docs.aide_revue: A new version sends the document back for review.
docs.titre: Contracts, mandates and reports filed by project, with their versions
docs.version_invalide: Attach the file and describe the change (3+ characters).

dossiers.aide_mode: The financial mode follows the file type and cannot be changed later. Trading is carried by GBS China and requires client verification.
dossiers.choisir: Select a file in the list.
dossiers.date_obligatoire: The site opening date is mandatory.
dossiers.introuvable: File not found or not allowed.

echantillons.aide: A sample's cost becomes a file cost, with its receipt. Charged to the client, it is invoiced at cost on a draft invoice of the file, only once; if borne by GBS, a reason is required.

erreurs.GBS_ACCORD_ECRIT_REQUIS: Without the client's written consent, only the anonymised version can be published.
erreurs.GBS_AGENT_INVALIDE: The contract must link a country agent to their own country.
erreurs.GBS_AO_CLOS: Tender submitted or closed: it can no longer be changed.
erreurs.GBS_AO_DATE_DEPASSEE: The deadline has passed: submission is impossible.
erreurs.GBS_AO_NON_DEPOSE: The result can only be recorded after submission.
erreurs.GBS_AO_PIECES_MANQUANTES: Every document must be ready before submission.
erreurs.GBS_APPROBATION_CIRCUIT: Technical approval goes through the client submission process.
erreurs.GBS_APPROBATION_EN_COURS: A version is already in preparation or submitted.
erreurs.GBS_APPROBATION_FIGEE: Submitted version: its documents can no longer change; submit a new version.
erreurs.GBS_APPROBATION_STATUT: Action not possible at this stage of the approval.
erreurs.GBS_APPROBATION_VIDE: Attach drawings or data sheets, or a sample.
erreurs.GBS_ARCHIVAGE_IMPOSSIBLE: Only a closed, non-archived file can be archived.
erreurs.GBS_ASSIGNE_INVALIDE: The task must be assigned to an active team member.
erreurs.GBS_AUCUNE_OFFRE: No offer recorded for this request.
erreurs.GBS_AUTO_VALIDATION: You cannot decide on your own declaration.
erreurs.GBS_AVENANT_FIGE: Only an amendment awaiting approval can be edited.
erreurs.GBS_AVENANT_INUTILE: Order not signed (edit it directly) or completed: no amendment.
erreurs.GBS_AVENANT_LIGNE_INVALIDE: Invalid amendment line: check the item, quantity and price.
erreurs.GBS_AVENANT_OBJET: A change of amount requires the "price" or "quantity" subject.
erreurs.GBS_AVENANT_PERIME: The order changed since the amendment was drafted: draft a new one.
erreurs.GBS_AVOIR_POSITIF: A credit note must have a negative amount.
erreurs.GBS_BENEFICIAIRES_MANQUANTS: Record at least one beneficial owner before approving.
erreurs.GBS_BORDEREAU_SUIVI: The destination country cargo tracking note is required before shipping.
erreurs.GBS_CADRE_INCOMPLET: Incomplete framework: dates and monthly fee required.
erreurs.GBS_CANAL_COMPTE: Channel does not match the account type.
erreurs.GBS_CATEGORIE_AUTOMATIQUE: The country agent commission is calculated automatically on receipt: do not enter it as a cost.
erreurs.GBS_CERTIFICAT_INCOHERENT: Certificate refused: data contradicts the credit, the order or the shipment.
erreurs.GBS_CHOIX_DEJA_ENREGISTRE: The client's choice is already recorded.
erreurs.GBS_CLIENT_NON_VERIFIE: Client verification required (trading or letter of credit).
erreurs.GBS_CLOTURE_CONDITIONS: Cannot close: blocking conditions are missing (documents, invoices, reservations, non-conformities or blocking issues).
erreurs.GBS_COMMANDE_AUTRE_DOSSIER: This order belongs to another file.
erreurs.GBS_COMMANDE_FIGEE: An order's file, supplier and currency cannot change.
erreurs.GBS_COMMANDE_REQUISE: Specify the order concerned by the supplier reservation.
erreurs.GBS_COMMISSION_IMPAYEE: Shipping awaits payment of the commission.
erreurs.GBS_COMMISSION_MODE1: Commission only applies to assisted purchases.
erreurs.GBS_COMPTE_AUTRE_FOURNISSEUR: This account does not belong to the order's supplier.
erreurs.GBS_COMPTE_BANCAIRE_FIGE: An account with statements cannot change company, number or currency.
erreurs.GBS_COMPTE_NON_VERIFIE: Payment refused: the account is not verified.
erreurs.GBS_CONSTAT_INVALIDE: The finding does not belong to this inspection.
erreurs.GBS_CONSULTATION_AUTRE_DOSSIER: The consultation belongs to another file.
erreurs.GBS_CONSULTATION_CLOSE: The consultation is closed: the deadline has passed.
erreurs.GBS_CONTRATS_CHEVAUCHES: This agent already has a contract for this period.
erreurs.GBS_CONTRAT_FIGE: Only a contract's end date can change; a new rate requires a new contract.
erreurs.GBS_CONTRAT_FIN_INVALIDE: The contract cannot end before a commission already calculated.
erreurs.GBS_CONTRAT_NON_SIGNE: Commission is invoiced when the first supplier contract is signed.
erreurs.GBS_CONTRE_INSPECTION_INVALIDE: Invalid re-inspection: same order, performed after the correction.
erreurs.GBS_CONTRE_INSPECTION_REFUSEE: The re-inspection does not confirm the correction.
erreurs.GBS_CONTRE_INSPECTION_REQUISE: A re-inspection is required to close a non-conformity of this severity.
erreurs.GBS_CONTROLES_INVALIDES: Invalid checks: result, source and (non-future) date required for each check entered.
erreurs.GBS_CONTROLE_NON_CONFORME: A check is not compliant: the verification cannot be approved.
erreurs.GBS_CORRECTION_INVALIDE: Describe the required correction (10 to 4,000 characters).
erreurs.GBS_COUT_GLOBAL_INVALIDE: Invalid life-cycle cost data: check the fields and their limits.
erreurs.GBS_COUT_NON_AFFECTE: Allocate the expense to a file or overheads before approving it.
erreurs.GBS_DATE_ENCAISSEMENT_INVALIDE: A receipt cannot be dated in the future.
erreurs.GBS_DATE_LIMITE_AVANCEE: Bids have been submitted: the deadline can be extended, never brought forward.
erreurs.GBS_DATE_LIVRAISON_INVALIDE: Invalid delivery date: neither future nor before the contract.
erreurs.GBS_DATE_OUVERTURE_ABSENTE: This file has no site opening date.
erreurs.GBS_DATE_OUVERTURE_OBLIGATOIRE: A site fit-out file requires the opening date, the fee and the reduced rate.
erreurs.GBS_DATE_PAIEMENT_INVALIDE: Invalid payment date: neither in the future nor before validation.
erreurs.GBS_DATE_RECEPTION_FUTURE: The receipt date cannot be in the future.
erreurs.GBS_DD_FIGEE: A due diligence reference cannot change.
erreurs.GBS_DD_REQUISE: A validated, unexpired due diligence is required.
erreurs.GBS_DECISION_RENDUE: Decision already made: it can no longer be changed.
erreurs.GBS_DEJA_RAPPROCHE: This receipt or payment is already confirmed by another bank transaction.
erreurs.GBS_DEJA_REPARTI: This cost is already split: enter a correction cost.
erreurs.GBS_DEJA_REPONDU: This question already has an answer.
erreurs.GBS_DELAIS_CIBLES_MANQUANTS: Target lead times missing: set them in the settings.
erreurs.GBS_DELAI_INVALIDE: Invalid deadline: from today, at most one year.
erreurs.GBS_DEVISE_COMPTE: Currency does not match the account.
erreurs.GBS_DEVISE_ENCAISSEMENT: The receipt must be recorded in the invoice currency.
erreurs.GBS_DEVISE_SOCIETE: Currency not allowed for this company (GBS CI: XOF; GBS China: USD or CNY).
erreurs.GBS_DEVIS_FIGE: A quote cannot change file or version.
erreurs.GBS_DEVIS_NON_ENVOYE: The quote must first be sent to the client.
erreurs.GBS_DEVIS_NON_SIGNE: No signed quote on this file.
erreurs.GBS_DOCUMENTS_INVALIDES: Invalid documents: only files uploaded to this file.
erreurs.GBS_DOCUMENT_ARCHIVE: Archived document: it can no longer be changed.
erreurs.GBS_DOCUMENT_DEJA_RECU: This document has already been received for this shipment.
erreurs.GBS_DOCUMENT_SANS_VERSION: Upload a version of the document first.
erreurs.GBS_DOCUMENT_SIGNE: Signed document: it can no longer change; create a new version or an amendment.
erreurs.GBS_DOCUMENT_VALIDE: Validated document: it can no longer change.
erreurs.GBS_DOSSIER_ARCHIVE: This file is archived: it is read-only.
erreurs.GBS_DOSSIER_AUTRE_CLIENT: This file belongs to another client.
erreurs.GBS_DOSSIER_FIGE: A file's company, client and opening date cannot change.
erreurs.GBS_DOSSIER_NON_CLOS: Only a closed file can produce a reference sheet.
erreurs.GBS_DOSSIER_QUALITE_INCOMPLET: Incomplete quality file: only the administrator can deliver it, with a reason.
erreurs.GBS_DOSSIER_SANS_LC: Declare the file “with letter of credit” (mode 1, verified client).
erreurs.GBS_ECHANTILLON_AVIS_REQUIS: Assessment and an opinion of at least 5 characters are required.
erreurs.GBS_ECHANTILLON_COUT_DEJA_SAISI: This sample's cost is already recorded.
erreurs.GBS_ECHANTILLON_ENVOI_INCOMPLET: Carrier, tracking number and shipping date are required.
erreurs.GBS_ECHANTILLON_NON_REFACTURABLE: This sample is not charged to the client.
erreurs.GBS_ECHEANCE_FACTUREE: Invoiced instalment: it can no longer change.
erreurs.GBS_ECHEANCIER_INCOHERENT: Instalments must add up to the project fee.
erreurs.GBS_ECHEANCIER_PROJET: Schedule reserved to site fit-out files.
erreurs.GBS_ENGAGEMENT_NON_COMMISSION: A supplier without a signed no-commission pledge cannot be approved.
erreurs.GBS_EN_PRODUCTION: Order launched: drawings change by amendment.
erreurs.GBS_ERREUR: An error occurred. Please try again.
erreurs.GBS_ESSAIS_MANQUANTS: A compliant, validated factory test is required before releasing the lot.
erreurs.GBS_EXPEDITION_INCONNUE: The shipment does not carry this order.
erreurs.GBS_EXPEDITION_LIVREE: Shipment delivered: no more forwarder link.
erreurs.GBS_EXPEDITION_NON_ARRIVEE: Reception follows the arrival of the file's shipment.
erreurs.GBS_EXPEDITION_VIDE: Attach at least one order to the shipment.
erreurs.GBS_FACTURE_EMISE: Issued invoice: it can no longer change; issue a credit note.
erreurs.GBS_FACTURE_FIGEE: An invoice's company, client, currency and type cannot change.
erreurs.GBS_FACTURE_INCOMPATIBLE: Choose a draft invoice of the same file.
erreurs.GBS_FACTURE_NON_EMISE: The invoice must be issued (and FNE-certified where required) before any receipt.
erreurs.GBS_FACTURE_NON_EN_ATTENTE: This invoice is not awaiting FNE certification.
erreurs.GBS_FACTURE_VIDE: Add at least one line before issuing.
erreurs.GBS_FICHE_EXISTANTE: This file already has a reference sheet.
erreurs.GBS_FICHE_INCOMPLETE: Need and solution are required before publishing.
erreurs.GBS_FICHE_PUBLIEE: Published sheet: it can no longer be changed.
erreurs.GBS_FICHIER_TAILLE: File empty or too large (25 MB max).
erreurs.GBS_FICHIER_TYPE: File type refused: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP only.
erreurs.GBS_FOURNISSEUR_HORS_DOSSIER: This supplier has neither offer nor order in this file.
erreurs.GBS_FOURNISSEUR_NON_AGREE: Supplier not approved or due diligence expired.
erreurs.GBS_FRET_ASSURANCE_REQUIS: A CIF or CIP bid must state freight and insurance.
erreurs.GBS_FRET_REQUIS: A CFR or CPT bid must state freight.
erreurs.GBS_GARANTIE_CLOSE: Guarantee released, called or refused: it can no longer be changed.
erreurs.GBS_HSE_INCOMPLET: Cannot start: certifications, permits, risk assessment or protective equipment missing.
erreurs.GBS_IMMUABLE: This record can be neither changed nor deleted.
erreurs.GBS_INCOTERM_BLOQUE: EXW and DDP require a reasoned administrator waiver.
erreurs.GBS_INCOTERM_NON_GERE: Incoterm not supported for FOB normalisation.
erreurs.GBS_INSPECTION_NON_LIBEREE: A released pre-shipment inspection of the order is required.
erreurs.GBS_INSPECTION_NON_REALISEE: The inspection must be completed before validation.
erreurs.GBS_INTERVENTION_FIGEE: Started intervention: its schedule and HSE requirements can no longer change.
erreurs.GBS_INTERVENTION_STATUT: Action not possible at this stage of the intervention.
erreurs.GBS_INTRAGROUPE_DEJA_EMIS: Intercompany invoices already issued for this month.
erreurs.GBS_JUSTIFICATIF_INVALIDE: Invalid receipt: upload it from the application.
erreurs.GBS_JUSTIFICATIF_MANQUANT: Receipt photo required for this category.
erreurs.GBS_LC_FIGEE: A certificate was issued on this credit: it can no longer be changed.
erreurs.GBS_LC_NON_CONFORME: Credit must be amended before any certificate.
erreurs.GBS_LIGNE_DEJA_TRAITEE: This transaction is already reconciled or classified.
erreurs.GBS_LIGNE_NON_TRAITEE: This transaction is not reconciled yet.
erreurs.GBS_LOT_INVALIDE: Lot size must be at least 2.
erreurs.GBS_MARCHANDISE_DANGEREUSE: Dangerous goods: safety data sheet and IMDG declaration required.
erreurs.GBS_MODE1_FONDS_CLIENT: In assisted purchase, the client pays the factory directly: GBS never pays on its behalf.
erreurs.GBS_MODE2_PAIEMENT_GBS: In trading, GBS China pays the supplier.
erreurs.GBS_MODE_FIGE: The financial mode is chosen at opening and cannot change.
erreurs.GBS_MOIS_NON_ECOULE: A statement is validated once the month has ended.
erreurs.GBS_MONTANTS_CALCULES: This amount is computed by the application and cannot be entered.
erreurs.GBS_MOTIF_INVALIDE: Comment too long (1,000 characters at most).
erreurs.GBS_MOTIF_OBLIGATOIRE: A reason of at least 5 characters is required.
erreurs.GBS_NC_FIGEE: The origin and severity of a non-conformity cannot be changed.
erreurs.GBS_NC_OUVERTE: An open non-conformity prevents validating the inspection.
erreurs.GBS_NC_STATUT: Action not possible at this stage of the non-conformity.
erreurs.GBS_NEGOCE_GBS_CHINE: Trading is carried by GBS China.
erreurs.GBS_NUMEROS_EN_TROP: More serial numbers than ordered units.
erreurs.GBS_OFFRE_EXISTANTE: An offer is already recorded for this supplier.
erreurs.GBS_OFFRE_INVALIDE: Incomplete or invalid offer: check price, lead time, warranty and figures.
erreurs.GBS_OFFRE_PLI_FIGEE: Sealed-bid offer: price and terms cannot be changed.
erreurs.GBS_PAIEMENT_FIGE: A payment order cannot change: reject it and prepare another.
erreurs.GBS_PAIEMENT_NON_VALIDE: The order must first be approved.
erreurs.GBS_PARAMETRE_INCONNU: Setting key not defined in the registry.
erreurs.GBS_PARAMETRE_INVALIDE: Value rejected: type, bounds or format do not match the setting definition (a rate is written 0.25 for 25%).
erreurs.GBS_PAYS_A_PRECISER: Specify the prospect's country before converting it to a client.
erreurs.GBS_PENALITE_SUR_SOLDE: A penalty is withheld only from the balance.
erreurs.GBS_PERIODE_INVALIDE: Invalid period (at most one year, end after start).
erreurs.GBS_PHOTOS_INVALIDES: Invalid photos: only files uploaded to this file, at most 20.
erreurs.GBS_PIECE_DD_FIGEE: A submitted document cannot change file: upload a new one.
erreurs.GBS_PIECE_DEJA_FOURNIE: This document has already been provided.
erreurs.GBS_PIECE_DEJA_RESERVEE: A part is already reserved for this claim.
erreurs.GBS_PIECE_FIGEE: The part stays attached to its file.
erreurs.GBS_PIECE_SANS_DOCUMENT: Upload the document before validating it.
erreurs.GBS_PLAFOND_WALLET: Above the WeChat Pay / Alipay ceiling, bank transfer is mandatory.
erreurs.GBS_PLIS_INDISPONIBLES: Offer submission temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
erreurs.GBS_PLI_ALTERE: Altered bid: its content does not match what was submitted. Opening refused.
erreurs.GBS_PLI_FERME: Sealed bids: the bid is recorded after the deadline.
erreurs.GBS_PLI_FIGE: A submitted bid cannot be changed.
erreurs.GBS_PREUVE_INVALIDE: Describe the correction made (10 to 4,000 characters).
erreurs.GBS_PROSPECT_CLOS: Converted or lost prospect: it can no longer be changed.
erreurs.GBS_PROSPECT_FIGE: The origin of a request cannot be changed.
erreurs.GBS_QUATRE_YEUX: Four-eyes control: the preparer cannot approve.
erreurs.GBS_QUATRE_YEUX_DELEGUE: Order prepared by the administrator: only the designated second person can approve it.
erreurs.GBS_QUESTION_DEJA_REPONDUE: This question has already been answered.
erreurs.GBS_RAPPORT_FIGE: An issued report cannot be changed: generate a new version.
erreurs.GBS_RAPPORT_REMPLACE: This report was superseded: the choice applies to the latest version.
erreurs.GBS_RAPPROCHEMENT_AVEC_FRAIS: This reconciliation created a bank charge: correct that cost first.
erreurs.GBS_RAPPROCHEMENT_INCOMPATIBLE: Cannot reconcile: different company, different currency or record not found.
erreurs.GBS_RAPPROCHEMENT_MONTANT: Amount difference outside the configured tolerance.
erreurs.GBS_RAPPROCHEMENT_SENS: Wrong direction: a credit confirms a receipt, a debit a payment or charges.

essais.aide: The test is compliant if all criteria are. It is validated with its signed report.
essais.exiges: Tests required by the approval: the lot will not be released without a compliant, validated test.

eth.aide_admin: Click a declaration to decide; you cannot decide on your own. Each decision requires a reason and is final.
eth.aide_declaration: The declarant is the signed-in person. A gift or invitation under the threshold is accepted automatically; anything else is decided by the administrator.
eth.aide_engagement: Without a signed commitment, the supplier cannot be approved.
eth.engagements_hors_droits: List reserved for purchasing and the administrator.
eth.regle: Any commission paid by a supplier to the company or a staff member is forbidden. Gifts accepted automatically up to {{s}}.
eth.titre: {{n}} declaration(s) this quarter; {{s}} of {{f}} supplier(s) signed the no-commission commitment

expeditions.aide_retard: The initial arrival ({{d}}) is kept; the gap shows in shipment tracking.
expeditions.aide_verrous: Moving to "shipped" requires: validated pre-shipment inspection for each order, commission paid, the destination country cargo tracking note, and for dangerous goods the safety data sheet, the IMDG declaration and, for lithium batteries, the UN38.3 report.
expeditions.franchise_demarre: The {{n}}-day free time starts on arrival at port.
expeditions.franchise_fin: Port arrival entered; the {{n}}-day free time ends on {{d}}.
expeditions.introuvable: Shipment not found or not allowed.
expeditions.retard_date: Enter an arrival date later than the current expected arrival.

factures.aide_devise: The receipt is recorded in the invoice currency ({{d}}), with the day's rate for reporting.
factures.aide_fne: Number and QR code returned by the DGI FNE platform. Without them, the invoice cannot be sent.
factures.aide_partage: Each receipt triggers the inter-company split and agents' commissions in the monthly statement.
factures.aide_societe: The invoicing company follows the financial model rule: Ivorian client, GBS Côte d'Ivoire for fees, commissions, framework agreements and installations (XOF, FNE); GBS China for services performed in China and trading (USD). Gabonese and Cameroonian clients: GBS China. The database refuses any other combination.
factures.bandeau_attente: FNE platform: the invoice awaits its number and QR code. It stays pending and is not sent to the client.
factures.bandeau_fne: {{n}} GBS Côte d'Ivoire invoice(s) await their FNE number and QR code: they are not sent to the client before certification.
factures.introuvable: Invoice not found or not allowed.
factures.mensualites_faites: {{n}} monthly fee(s) invoiced. A month already invoiced is never invoiced twice.
factures.qr_attendu: DGI FNE QR expected on certification

fiche.aide_annulation: Before the supplier contract is signed: no commission due. After signing and before production: the first half is kept. After production starts: the full commission is due. Credit notes and invoices are issued automatically; unshipped orders are cancelled.
fiche.annulation_apres_production: File cancelled after production started: the full commission is due.
fiche.annulation_avant_contrat: File cancelled before the supplier contract: no commission is due.
fiche.annulation_avant_production: File cancelled before production: the first half of the commission is kept.
fiche.aucune_piece: No document required for this phase.
fiche.derogation_texte: Move to the next phase despite a missing mandatory document. The reason is written to the audit log.
fiche.frais_engages: Costs incurred (inspection days, travel, samples) must be re-invoiced at cost on a separate invoice.
fiche.regles_datees: dated rules applied as of this date
fiche.titre_intenable: opening at risk: {{n}} working days of projected delay
fiche.titre_marge: {{n}} working days of margin before opening
fiche.transparence_note: Shown separately to the client · no supplier commission.
fiche.verrou_contrat: No purchase without a signed contract

flux.aide_regles: Commission is only due after the client's payment. A changed rule applies to receipts after its date.
flux.ci_vers_cn: Owed by GBS CI to GBS China
flux.cn_vers_ci: Owed by GBS China to GBS CI
flux.releve: Statement by file: original receipt, rule and effective date
flux.titre: Value sharing and flows between GBS China and GBS Côte d'Ivoire
flux.titre_releve: {{mois}} statement: {{n}} shared receipts, {{c}} XOF of country agent commissions

formulaire.invalide: Missing or invalid field: please check your entry.

fournisseurs.aide_compte: The account must belong to the company on the business licence, never to an individual. It can only be used after verification by a second person.
fournisseurs.aide_comptes: An account can only be used for payments after verification by a second person.
fournisseurs.apporte_client: Supplier brought by the client (inspection only)

gar.aide: Accrued commission = amount × annual rate × days since issue (until release) / 365, computed by the database.
gar.alerte_commission: An expired guarantee without release keeps costing the bank commission ({{p}} % per year).
gar.dates_invalides: Issue date today or earlier, expiry later.
gar.motif_appel: Reason for the call by the beneficiary

grille.aide: Each rule is dated and versioned: a new version applies from its effective date; history is kept.
grille.aide_version: The last bracket stays open. The version applies from the effective date; the database checks the scale before saving.
grille.invalide: Invalid scale: increasing bounds, rates between 0 and 100 %, reason of at least 3 characters.
grille.lecture: The bracket is read on the file's total FOB value, in FCFA.
grille.minimum_aide: Per file; the higher amount applies
grille.premiere_facture_aide: Share invoiced when the first contract is signed
grille.sur_mesure_aide: Added to the rate for custom-made lines

imp.aide: A published rule is not edited: deactivate it and create a new one; history stays in the log.
imp.aide_regle: Country: two-letter code (CI, GA, CM…) or * for all; the rule applies from its effective date.
imp.aucune_exigence: No required document for this country and category.
imp.aucune_regle: No rule: the administrator enters required documents by country and category.
imp.bloque: {{n}} regulatory document(s) missing: clearance blocked at destination
imp.code_invalide: Code in lowercase and _ (2–40), label of at least 2 characters.
imp.titre: Rules by country and category; each shipment is checked against its required documents

inspections.aide_critique: Critical defects: zero tolerance (Ac 0). Sample size and thresholds follow ISO 2859-1, normal inspection, single sampling.
inspections.derogation_liberation: The proposed decision is rejection: release requires a reasoned waiver by the administrator.
inspections.introuvable: Inspection not found or not allowed.

interventions.aide_cout: Actual cost = time spent × rate + approved linked expenses; invoiced at actual cost plus {{p}} (dated setting), computed in the database.
interventions.aucun_incident: No incident or near miss reported.
interventions.aucune_habilitation_a_renouveler: No certification to renew within 30 days.

controles.permis: permit missing or not covering the dates

interventions.cout_detail: {{h}} h · actual cost {{reel}} · to invoice (cost + markup) {{facture}}
interventions.permis_requis: Work permits required by the site
interventions.titre_synthese: {{p}} intervention(s) to carry out; {{f}} completed to invoice

journal.aide: Every action is time-stamped, attributed to its author and chained to the previous one. No line can be changed or deleted.
journal.choisir: Select a line to see before and after.
journal.integre: Integrity verified · hash chain intact ({{n}} lines)

lc.a_amender: Ask the client for an amendment
lc.aide: The credit must name Gulf Bridge Sourcing as certificate issuer and set its wording; the certificate reproduces that wording verbatim and is issued only if no data contradicts the credit, the order or the shipment.
lc.aide_emission: The certificate reproduces the wording above verbatim; quantities, dates and ports are checked before issue.
lc.aide_saisie: Copy the wording and the document list exactly as written in the credit. Any change restarts the analysis.

anomalies.certificat_non_exige: the inspection certificate is not among the required documents
anomalies.date_expedition: latest shipment date before the promised delivery
anomalies.emetteur_non_gbs: the credit does not name Gulf Bridge Sourcing as certificate issuer

livraison.aide_douane: Steps read from the database: link sent to the forwarder, declaration and release filed by them. Payment of duties and taxes is not tracked yet.
livraison.aucune: No shipment has arrived at port.
livraison.titre_reserves: {{n}} reservation(s) to lift before final acceptance

nc.aide_cloture: Critical or major: choose a re-inspection performed after the correction whose proposed decision is acceptance.
nc.aide_declaration: Describe the correction made by the supplier and attach photos.
nc.aide_note: Score out of 100 over a rolling 12 months: each non-conformity deducts points by severity, more if the correction is late.

neg.aide_conditions: Price and clause as signed with the client; every change is logged.
neg.alerte_acompte: Deposits paid to suppliers exceed the client deposit by {{m}}: the company carries the risk.
neg.alerte_taux: An exchange rate is missing for a currency of this file: the margin is not computed until it is entered.
neg.simulation: If the CNY rises by {{p}}: margin {{m}} ({{t}}).

ouverture.aide: Latest dates computed backwards from the opening using target lead times, in working days; projected finish computed from the actual state of the file. Closing follows the opening and is not included.
ouverture.avance: Ahead of the opening date: {{n}} working day(s).
ouverture.cibles_manquantes: Backward schedule impossible: no target lead time for {{liste}} (Settings → Target lead times).
ouverture.intenable: Opening date not achievable: projected end on {{date}}, {{n}} working day(s) late.
ouverture.intenable_tache: Opening date not achievable: {{n}} working day(s) projected delay

pack.aide: One file gathers the documents expected by the client's bank and forwarder, renamed by document, with a summary (domiciliation reference, certificate).
pack.aide_projet: Enter the draft as received from the carrier: it is checked against the shipment, the orders and the letter of credit. If compliant, the “validated draft” document is validated too.
pack.controler_projet: Check a draft bill of lading

ecarts.date_chargement_lc: Loading after the credit's latest date
ecarts.poids_inferieur_net: Gross weight below the net weight of items

paiements.aide_conditions: Indicative conditions: the database checks them again on approval and execution (verified accounts, signed contract, release inspection or waiver).
paiements.aide_mode1: Assisted purchase: GBS never receives or pays funds intended for the supplier. The instruction is sent to the client, who pays the factory and provides proof.
paiements.aide_mode2: Trading: GBS China pays the supplier, only to a verified account, after approval by a second person.
paiements.aide_quatre_yeux: Four-eyes control: the person who prepares an order cannot approve it. {{nom}}, you only see the "Validate" button on orders prepared by someone else.
paiements.aucun_compte: No verified account: payment is not possible.
paiements.titre_file: {{n}} payments to approve, {{b}} blocked; only verified accounts and approved inspections can be paid

parametrage.aide: A setting is never edited: you create a new value with an effective date. A file keeps the rule in force when it was opened.
parametrage.aide_cle: Only keys defined in the registry are accepted (e.g. cout_global.energie_xof_kwh.SN for a new country).
parametrage.aide_compte_externe: Links this account to a single client or supplier: it will only see that party's area. Only open after the portal rules are approved and a penetration test.
parametrage.aide_date: The value will apply to files opened from the effective date.
parametrage.aide_rattachements: Applied when a prospect becomes a client. A rule is never edited: add a new one with its effective date. “defaut” covers countries without a rule.
parametrage.aide_taux: 1 currency unit = n XOF. XOF and XAF share the same fixed euro peg but remain two distinct codes.
parametrage.aide_utilisateurs: A new account has no rights until the administrator assigns a role. Two-factor authentication is required at every sign-in.
parametrage.comptes_aucun: No account visible with your rights.
parametrage.delegue_aide: Second person designated to approve payments prepared by the administrator
parametrage.json_invalide: The value must be valid JSON.
parametrage.titre: Dated settings, rates, users and companies

penalites.aide: Amount = goods value × daily rate × days late, within the contract cap. The promised date follows signed amendments.
penalites.motif_renonciation: Reason if the withholding is below the penalty
penalites.proposee: Late-delivery penalty proposed as withholding: {{montant}} ({{jours}} days late).
penalites.sans_clause: No penalty clause in the contract (daily rate not set).

pieces.aide_catalogue: Taken from the supplier's response (parts prices and availability period); parts selected by the client become contract commitments.
pieces.aide_demande: The request is dated. While the document is missing, a follow-up task is created for the phase owner every 3 working days; beyond 10 working days, it becomes a blocking issue (configurable lead times).
pieces.aide_devis: Client price calculated by the database: supplier price in accompanied purchase (the client pays the supplier), plus the trading margin otherwise. Signed quote: the list no longer changes.
pieces.aucune_catalogue: No part recorded for this supplier.

planning.aucun_ferie: No upcoming holiday in the calendar.
planning.aucune_date: No open file has a site opening date.
planning.aucune_echeance: No running due date: set phase target lead times in settings.
planning.cal_reportees: {{n}} due dates pushed back by a holiday
planning.cal_surtitre: Lead times in working days, country holidays excluded
planning.cal_suspendus: {{n}} lead times paused while waiting on a third party
planning.gnt_intenable: {{client}} can no longer meet its opening date
planning.gnt_marge: {{client}} has only {{n}} days of margin left
planning.plan_initial: Thin line: latest-date plan computed backwards from the opening date; bar: actual or projected start and end.
planning.regle_calcul: Weekends and country holidays excluded; exceptional working days included.
planning.rpl_titre: {{client}} opens on {{date}}; {{n}} working days of margin left
planning.rpl_titre_intenable: {{client}} opens on {{date}}; {{n}} working days of projected delay
planning.rpl_titre_sans: {{client}} opens on {{date}}; target lead times incomplete

plis.aide_cout_global: Without this data, your offer is flagged as incomplete.
plis.aide_equipe: Bid contents stay encrypted until the deadline, for everyone. The deadline can be extended, never brought forward once a bid is submitted.
plis.aide_ouverture: Deadline passed: opening decrypts each bid, checks it was not altered and records it as an offer.
plis.aide_questions: Answers are shared with all consulted suppliers, without saying who asked.
plis.aide_reponses: A published answer is visible to all invited suppliers, without the name of who asked.
plis.close: The deadline has passed: offers are no longer accepted.
plis.confidentialite: Your offer is encrypted as soon as it is sent: no one at Gulf Bridge Sourcing can read it before the deadline. Other suppliers never see your prices or your identity.
plis.depose_ok: Offer received and encrypted. Keep the receipt below.
plis.lien_cree: Link created for {{f}}: it will not be shown again, send it now (WeChat, e-mail).
plis.remplacer: Replace your offer (only the last one counts)

portail.aide_demande: A few words are enough: your project manager will clarify the need with you.
portail.aide_documents: Your project's validated documents, kept and downloadable at any time.
portail.aide_factures: Our fees are invoiced separately from the manufacturer's invoice, which you pay directly to the factory.
portail.aide_production: Order progress and quality control results. Inspection results are shown once validated by our team.
portail.aucun_dossier: No project in progress for your company.
portail.aucune_action: Nothing is required from you right now.
portail.demande_envoyee: Request sent: your project manager will get back to you.
portail.demande_invalide: Describe the need in at least 10 characters; date as day/month/year.

portail.marge_planning: working days of slack in the schedule
portail.transmettre: Send these documents to your project manager; online upload is coming in a later version.

portail_f.aide_agrement: An expired due diligence or an unsigned commitment suspends new requests for quotation.
portail_f.aide_compte: To change account, contact purchasing: any new account is verified before any payment.
portail_f.aide_cotations: Your bid stays sealed until the deadline, then all offers are opened together. To submit an offer, use the secure link received for each request.
portail_f.aide_paiements: The balance is paid once all conditions are met; Gulf Bridge Sourcing checks the documents and takes nothing from payments to the factory.
portail_f.ethique: Gulf Bridge Sourcing forbids any commission or kickback. If a staff member asks for one, report it to management.
portail_f.paiement_direct: The client pays the factory directly
portail_f.resume: : {{c}} quotation(s) to submit, {{o}} order(s) in progress

portefeuille.lecture_marge: The margin before the opening date is recalculated at every milestone; the client sees it on their tracking page.

lectures.attente_tiers: The current phase is waiting on a third party (client, supplier or carrier).
lectures.bloquant: A blocking issue is open: it must be cleared before moving to the next phase.
lectures.intenable: At the current pace, the site opening date cannot be met.
lectures.nc_ouverte: Status “Open NC”: a non-conformity awaits correction.

portefeuille.titre_marge: {{n}} opening date(s) with a thin margin

prix.aide_consultation: The last supplier is no longer approved: a new tender is required.
prix.aide_reassort: Same product, same approved supplier: the reorder benefits from the commission cut by half.
prix.aucun: No price recorded: prices come from order lines.
prix.surtitre: price history by product and supplier
prix.titre: {{n}} products can be reordered, with a commission cut by half

prospects.alerte_sans_contact: {{n}} prospect(s) without first contact within one working day.

qualite.synthese: {{p}} of {{n}} selected item(s) ready, in the "{{r}}" format

cg.sav_afrique: After-sales service in West and Central Africa

reception.nc_ouverte: Non-conformity opened on the supplier order

ref.preuve_requise: The client's consent requires written proof.

regles.partage_cn_vers_ci_frais_gestion: Management fees due to GBS CI

sommaire.trop_petit: Screen too small for the mosaic

stock.aide: Stock only changes through traced movements; an issue beyond stock is refused; average cost is recomputed on each receipt. Interventions are invoiced at actual cost plus mark-up.
stock.aide_creation: Quantity starts at zero: then record a receipt with its cost.
stock.reference_invalide: Reference as PR-XXXX (capitals, digits, hyphens), name and threshold required.
stock.titre: {{site}} stock: {{n}} item(s) at threshold or out of stock

suivi.aide_equipe: Personal read-only link for the client: milestones, approved authorised documents, invoices, margin on the opening date. Never supplier prices or margins. The link is shown only once; revoke it if it has been shared.
suivi.aide_lien: This link is invalid, expired or revoked. Ask your Gulf Bridge Sourcing contact for a new link.
suivi.aucun_lien: No tracking link for this file.
suivi.avance: Ahead of the opening date: {{n}} working day(s).
suivi.lien: Link to send to the client
suivi.lien_unique: This link will not be shown again: copy it now. Only its fingerprint is kept.
suivi.liens_temporaires: Download links are valid for 5 minutes; reload the page to get new ones.
suivi.ouverture_non_calculee: The margin on the opening date will be shown once the schedule is set.
suivi.retard: Projected delay on the opening date: {{n}} working day(s). Your contact will get in touch.
suivi.retards_total: {{n}} days of delay in total, broken down by party.
suivi.validite: This personal link is valid until {{date}}. Do not forward it.

suivi_dossiers.blq_titre_impact: {{n}} days of cumulative impact on schedules
suivi_dossiers.pcm_titre_bloque: {{n}} mandatory ones block the next phase

transitaire.aide_equipe: The forwarder only sees this shipment: no prices, no client, no other file. Their milestones stay hidden from the client until published; their documents are filed in the case.
transitaire.lien_actif: Active link for {{d}} until {{date}} · opened {{n}} times

trc.aide: Millions of FCFA, consolidated at the latest known rate, intra-group flows excluded. Sources: latest statements, client invoices to collect, pending supplier payments, planned flows. Foreign-currency amounts without an entered rate are not counted.
trc.aucune: No forecast: import a bank statement and enter planned flows.
trc.titre_negatif: Negative cash forecast over {{n}} weeks; low point {{m}} M FCFA in {{s}} ({{p}})
trc.titre_positif: Cash positive over {{n}} weeks; low point {{m}} M FCFA in {{s}} ({{p}})

verif.aide_beneficiaires: Any shareholder entry or exit, or change of share, voids the client verification: it must be redone.
verif.aide_saisie: For each check: result, source consulted (register, sanctions list, credit report) and date. Approval requires all five checks compliant and at least one beneficial owner; it is done by the administrator, never by the author of the checks.
